Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Corrupter
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Clan: Follower of Set
Unique master.
Put this card on a ready Follower of Set you control. Whenever this vampire puts a corruption counter in play, he or she puts 2 corruptions counters in play instead.
It's supposed to improve corruption counters decks which are quite unexisting right now.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> It's supposed to improve corruption counters decks which are quite unexisting right now.
>
Well, part of the problem is that corruption is like combat, but worse : you lose a vampire, your predator / prey gain one. When it work, it's quickly overwhelming. When it don't work, it suck.

So, it need very careful test to see if the balance is good enough. Maybe "add one more if there were none" would be enough. Maybe that even with this card, using 2-5 actions to take control of a vampire is too much.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Ohlmann wrote:
> So, it need very careful test to see if the balance is good enough. Maybe "add one more if there were none" would be enough. Maybe that even with this card, using 2-5 actions to take control of a vampire is too much.
>
What about if putting Corruption counters also helped with pool damage, so the slowness was less bad?

Corrupter
Unique master. Archetype.
Put this card on a vampire you control. When this vampire succeeds in an action to put a corruption counter on another Methuselah's minion, that Methuselah also burns 1 pool. A vampire may have only one archetype.

So, Nefertiti, Corruption, Reformation, Relevation of Ecstasy (superior), Cave of Apples all qualify.

Less bothered about a clan requirement - why not let an Anarch Gangrel with Serpentis try it if they really want? Unsure about pool cost. Really, I'm just suggesting a possible mechanism that might be interesting, which could be appropriately costed later.

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: Corruption counters are meant as anti weenie thing, and against bigger guys they can already be used for pool damage with Revelation of Desire.

Messages.Author: Surreal
Messages.Body:
I like the idea but corruption counters should have more benefits than just stealing minions. Minion steal works ok with weenies and allies but almost useless against big caps. Revelation of Desire is good example for a good card.

Name: Corrupter
Cardtype: Master
Unique master. Archetype.
Put this card on a ready vampire you control and this vampire becomes Red List. Whenever this vampire puts a corruption counter in play, he or she puts one extra corruption counter. While this vampire is acting minions with corruption counters cannot block or play reaction cards.

Strong card but it's unique and you have to play some corruption tech and take care of red list. Red list could removed tho and make card weaker but I would like to see some reaction or block denial with theme of corruption counters. Straight pool damage with adding counter is not so creative, FoS have PRE and votes for ousting anyway.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
I'd agree that if you're going to add a "Cannot block" then you would need it to cost at least 1 pool and make it "your corruption counters".

Corrupter
Master
1 pool
Unique Master. Archetype.
Put this card on a ready vampire you control. Whenever this vampire puts a corruption counter on a ready minion, put an additional counter on that minion. While this vampire is acting minions with your corruption counters must burn 1 blood to attempt to block. A vampire may have only one archetype.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418
